_meta.render: pdftoppm -jpeg -r 110; page 2 totals column re-rendered at -r 260
_meta.notes: The ORIGINAL 2007 year-end report (its amendment is key 2db59d51, which changed only a donor name, not any amount). Older template (04pccfindisc.doc); Column B is headed 'Aggregate Total'; the top-row 'Office' box also reads 'MAYOR'. Neither amendment box is checked. Figures are written without thousands commas ('77158.77', '30865.39', '70306.91', '147465.68'); line 7 is written with a space ('116 600.29'); line 2 Column B and line 6 use a DECIMAL COMMA ('30865,39'), recorded verbatim. Confirmed at 260 dpi; every line reconciles (70,306.91 + 77,158.77 = 147,465.68; − 30,865.39 = 116,600.29). Note the large carried-in balance on line 3 with no prior report in this chunk.

contributions.detail: exact (77,158.77 = 77,158.77); Schedule A also prints its own grand total 77,158.77 on p8 and the 202 transcribed rows sum to it to the cent

expenditures.detail: exact (30,865.39 = 30,865.39); Schedule B prints its own grand total 30,865.39 on p10 and the 73 transcribed rows sum to it to the cent

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NO page prints 'SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE' - the schedules are a typed spreadsheet attachment, not the pre-printed clerk sheet, so the per-page gate cannot fire on any page. The only printed sums are the two schedule GRAND totals (p8 $77,158.77 for A, p10 $30,865.39 for B) and both gate exactly against the transcribed rows: A p3 17,975.00 + p4 25,840.00 + p5 11,400.00 + p6 7,880.00 + p7 8,860.08 + p8 5,203.69 = 77,158.77; B p9 24,971.70 + p10 5,893.69 = 30,865.39.
itemized.escalation_note: p4 mailing-address cell (row 1, Sara Rich) re-rendered as an 800 dpi tight crop and rotated - the only legible address in the filing; city/state only taken.
itemized.notes: Schedules A and B are a typed spreadsheet attachment printed LANDSCAPE (A, PDF pages 3-8; rotated 90 deg CCW to read) and PORTRAIT (B, PDF pages 9-10). Internal page numbering is inconsistent with the PDF: the Schedule A sheets are headed 'PAGE 4 OF 12' and the first Schedule B sheet 'PAGE 8 OF 8'. The COMPLETE MAILING ADDRESS column is blank/whited on every row except p4 row 1, so donor_city/donor_state are blank throughout by source - the filer's address data did not print, it was not redacted by the county. The form carries OCCUPATION and EMPLOYER columns for many contributors; the per-row contract has no slot for them so they are not transcribed. 33 in-kind items appear on BOTH schedules (Schedule A p7-p8 and Schedule B p9-p10) and both printed grand totals include them, so they are transcribed on both sides as the form presents them - do not treat the duplication as double counting by the transcriber. Two in-kind recipient names are spelled differently between the two schedules (Precision/Pewcision Physical Therapy; XPEDX/XPRDX) and both spellings are kept verbatim. One expenditure date is a filer typo ('5/31/2000' on a 2007-period report) and is kept verbatim. Cover page is stamped COPY and RECEIVED JAN 31 2008; the summary page (p2) was already transcribed by the totals tranche and was not redone.
